verdict.rationale: Edison/FutureHouse documents agents that take a user's own datasets and return AI-generated analyses, hypotheses and cited reports: Kosmos works from a research objective plus datasets, and Analysis turns raw experimental data into statistical results and figures. Data upload and artifact review are also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and documentation of the in-app (non-API) experience for getting data-driven suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Given a research objective and one or more datasets, Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.
It turns raw data into detailed analyses, statistical results, and publication-ready figures.
